research_projects_dates_check.name: research_projects_dates_check
research_projects_dates_check.value: "research_projects"."expected_completion_date" is null or "research_projects"."start_date" is null or "research_projects"."expected_completion_date" >= "research_projects"."start_date"

research_tasks_actual_dates_check.name: research_tasks_actual_dates_check
research_tasks_actual_dates_check.value: "research_tasks"."actual_end_date" is null or "research_tasks"."actual_start_date" is null or "research_tasks"."actual_end_date" >= "research_tasks"."actual_start_date"

review_requests_decision_check.name: review_requests_decision_check
review_requests_decision_check.value: ("review_requests"."status" not in ('approved', 'changes_requested')) or ("review_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "review_requests"."decided_at" is not null)

review_requests_not_self_check.name: review_requests_not_self_check
review_requests_not_self_check.value: "review_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is distinct from "review_requests"."submitted_by_user_id" or "review_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is null
